title: Dynamic Strategy Engine — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Revises plans when conditions, resources, or mission objectives change. The Dynamic Strategy Engine watches an executing plan and revises it when reality diverges: resources shrink, objectives shift, or new information arrives. It re-scores options against the updated situation, produces a revised plan with a changelog explaining what changed and why, and never abandons the mission goal without explicit authorization. Capability specification: a design target describing what such an engine must do, not a claim of a deployed implementation.
